title: Thought I was getting different tongs. Don't like these.
text:
Thought I was getting different tongs. Don't like these.. I'm Not happy with this oxo tongs.

I thought I was buying tongs I bought a while ago that are hard to find, although not expensive.
The oxo nylon head (tongs) does not close down on the food like I'm use to, or pick up the food I'm cooking very easy.
The tong head is pretty short, although the length is 9 inch, like my old one.

This is heavier, and odd to handle for me!. Maybe its the short tong, that seems uncomfortable, and just doesn't work for me!
It seems to be well made as my other oxo utensils are.

That said, I was at Ross the other day, and low and behold, there was the Tongs I already had,and wanted in black & stainless for about $4.00 bucks.
If they had more, I would have bought them.

This one sits in the drawer..
I'll gave it to someone who wants it.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips 9-Inch Locking Tongs with Nylon Heads
features: Versatile for cooking, tossing and transferring food
Tongs lock closed for convenient storage
Soft, comfortable, non-slip grips and thumb rests
Nylon heads are high-heat resistant and safe for non-stick cookware
description: A kitchen essential, a good pair of tongs will see you through the toughest cooking tasks while protecting your busy hands from the heat of the oven or stovetop. The OXO Good Grips 9-inch Tongs with Nylon Heads are constructed with sturdy, high-heat resistant nylon, so they’ll stand up to hot grills while being safe for your non-stick skillets. Our Tongs feature scalloped edges for a secure grip whether you're rotating thin asparagus or flipping a thick steak. The handles provide a non-slip grip and absorb pressure so you can grip, toss, turn and flip with comfort and control. The Tongs lock closed for compact storage when hanging or in a drawer. The 9-in/22.5 cm size fits comfortably in the hand. Dishwasher safe. Also available in 12-inch size.

Not only do these 9-inch tongs cushion hands and provide thumb rests, which are useful when gripping heavy objects, but the nylon heads wont scratch nonstick cookware. Doubling as a hang loop, a tab on the bottom pulls out to lock the stainless-steel tongs shut, allowing them to slip easily into a drawer. The nylon heads are heat-resistant to 400 degrees Fahrenheit, and the tongs are dishwasher-safe.
